title: [material] Convert utils and six barrels to TypeScript
body:
Converts `@mui/material/utils` and the six directories where only the barrel was still `.js` (`NoSsr`, `Popper`, `Portal`, `TextareaAutosize`, `Unstable_TrapFocus`, `useMediaQuery`). Follows #49143 and #49180.

Emitted JS is unchanged and nothing outside these seven directories moved. A type-equivalence probe covers all seven subpaths.

Two deletions:

- `utils/shouldSpreadAdditionalProps`: no importers anywhere in the repo, no `.d.ts`, not in the barrel, and the deep path is not reachable through the exports wildcard.
- `utils/useRovingTabIndex.js`: a duplicate of `useRovingTabIndex.ts`. Both compiled to the same output path and the `.ts` won, so the `.js` and its `'use client'` have never shipped. The build is byte-identical without it. A sweep of all package sources found no other collision.

Declaration changes:

- `utils/index` lists the nine `./types` names explicitly, since `'use client'` forbids `export *`.
- `unstable_ClassNameGenerator` keeps the type the hand-written `.d.ts` gave it, already broader than the wrapper it points at.
- `useMediaQuery` becomes `declare const` with the same generic signature, and its `export *` from `@mui/system/useMediaQuery` becomes `export type *`, matching a runtime that never re-exported those values.
- `NoSsr`, `Portal` and `TextareaAutosize` drop `export * from './X'`. Those files only export a default, so it re-exported nothing; ESLint flags it once it moves into a `.ts`.

`package.json` gains seven entries, one per converted directory.
